simulation_goal: Stress-test OmniConnect Sentinel's technical architecture, security invariants, operational deployability, UX friction, regulatory claims, and commercial GTM viability inside a multi-agent enterprise digital world to uncover fatal and non-fatal flaws.

entities.name: Red-Team Hardware & Windows/Linux Internals Attacker
motives: Bypass Ring 3 pre-mount hold before userspace sees USB volume
Exploit non-mass-storage interfaces (BadUSB HID, RNDIS/ECM network gadget, MTP/PTP phones, Thunderbolt/USB4 DMA)
Abuse CDR parser edge cases, ProjFS fallback races, or localhost UI/IPC boundaries
constraints: Physical access to USB port or supply-chain compromised flash drive

entities.name: Fortune 500 CISO & Enterprise Security Buyer
motives: Consolidate vendors (reduce agent sprawl on endpoints)
Justify every dollar against existing Microsoft E5 / CrowdStrike Falcon licenses
Avoid catastrophic operational outages or vendor abandonment risk
constraints: Strict procurement / SOC 2 / Cyber Insurance requirements

entities.name: Incumbent EDR & CDR Product Strategist (CrowdStrike / Microsoft / OPSWAT)
motives: Identify commoditizable features absorbable into existing kernel/OS platforms
Expose where OPSWAT MetaDefender Kiosk or Microsoft Defender ASR already dominates
Attack weak pricing power ($8-$18/seat/mo) and missing central management plane
constraints: Must protect incumbent market share and enterprise bundle lock-in

entities.name: OT / ICS SCADA Substation & Manufacturing Engineer
motives: Keep turbines/PLCs running with zero unplanned downtime
Transfer 2GB-32GB vendor PLC firmware images, CAD files, and proprietary encrypted installers safely
Pass IEC 62443-3-3 SL-3 audits on truly air-gapped Windows LTSC / legacy stations
constraints: Strict vendor warranty rules on unmodified firmware packages

entities.name: Enterprise Endpoint / Intune MDM Infrastructure Engineer (50k Fleet)
motives: Deploy agents silently without breaking BitLocker, USB-C docks, phones, smartcards, printers, or external dev SSDs
Minimize L1/L2 helpdesk tickets and emergency break-glass requests
Maintain OS compatibility across Windows 10/11 Home/Pro/Enterprise and Ubuntu/RHEL

entities.name: Field Engineer / Senior Developer / Finance Analyst
motives: Open Excel financial models with macros, signed PDF contracts, CAD zips, and large datasets immediately
Route around annoying security friction via cloud links, personal phones, or Shadow IT
constraints: Zero patience for silently mangled files or 512 MiB errors

entities.name: GRC Compliance Auditor & Enterprise Technology Counsel
motives: Verify every compliance badge against actual cryptographic and procedural certification standards
Flag overclaimed FIPS 140-3/186-5, NIST SP 800-88 Rev 1 vs Rev 2, IEC 62443 SL-3, and SOC 2 compliance
Identify legal liability from CDR document alteration (invalidated e-signatures, financial/medical data loss)
constraints: Zero tolerance for uncertified crypto or misleading claims

anti_bias_rules: No agent may endorse willingness-to-pay without specifying what budget line item gets cut.
Every technical flaw must cite real source files or documented architectural constraints.
Agents must cross-examine and challenge overly optimistic or speculative claims from other agents in Round 2.
